Privacy & how AI works

Your notes and requests are saved in this browser. Anyone using this browser profile can see them. Clear them using the control below. There are no shared accounts or automatic messages.

AI uses WebLLM and Qwen2.5 locally. Notes are not sent to an AI server. External providers receive requests to download the runtime and model. Internet is needed for downloads; offline use is not guaranteed.

Village organises practical help. It does not give medical or recovery advice.
